title: Bulk Publish Skips Entries Silently When a Required Field Is Empty
alternate_search_terms: bulk publish no error but entries not published
why did bulk publish not publish all entries

extracted_facts.problem: A bulk publish action silently skipped some entries without any error, leaving them unpublished.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The skipped entries had a required field left empty. The CMS validates required fields only during publish, not during the bulk selection step, so the entries were selectable for bulk publish but failed validation silently when the publish attempt reached them.
resolution_steps: Fill in the missing required field.
Run the bulk publish attempt again and confirm all entries publish successfully.
